materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/OA package, supplement PDF text/table index, and linked APD6/DBAASP packet rows were exhausted for worker-2/4/6 blockers. Remaining limitations are preserved as cautions, not blocking gaps.

summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered the primary Table 1 activity matrix, reconciled DBAASP assay rows to those source-backed records, preserved APD6 entry-text rows as database-only cautions, and bounded mechanism claims to phenotypic/SAR evidence. The paper is publication-grade with cautions and no open rework target for worker-2/4/6.
adjudication_summary: Worker-6 compared the repaired activity, database, mechanism, packet manifest, supplement, and source paths. No blocking/major issue remains after preserving nonblocking database and toxicity/mechanism cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay rows were source-matched to XML Table 1 by peptide key, target strain, and concentration; APD6 entry-text rows remain database_only_no_primary_source because exact structured identity/activity fields are absent from the linked rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: XML Table 1 yields 160 source-backed antibacterial vLD rows with units, target strains, conditions, statistics, and locators. Local sources do not report host toxicity/hemolysis rows, so none are fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Final mechanism output is limited to phenotypic antibacterial activity, indirect structure-activity/self-association interpretation, and direct Crp14 structural evidence. No direct antimicrobial target mechanism is overclaimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains material_extracted_with_gaps because supplement tables are not structured, but the owned worker-2/4/6 blockers are recoverable from XML/PDF/database paths.

caution_findings.evidence_context: 11 APD6 entry_text rows remain database_only_no_primary_source because they lack structured peptide/target/concentration fields despite DOI traceability.
No host cytotoxicity or hemolysis assay rows were recovered from local XML/PDF/supplement text.
Mechanism conclusions are restricted to phenotypic killing and structure/activity/self-association context.

Two DBAASP rows assign the Crp1 S. aureus vLD50 value to the L-Crp1 sequence key; Table 1 does not support that assignment, so both duplicate database rows remain source_conflict with locators instead of being smoothed.
